Uber commenced operations of Europe’s first fully driverless robotaxi service in Croatia, featuring zero human safety drivers [1](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivAFBVV95cUxQQ09uc1FWTGJmNVBER3NyVENJMHVfYWJYcENNdjhsc3dRSkxDejFYdmdOSUFvM1dMNHlCNzVTc0sxZWJzdEdmWmZ1NXZzRmx5aElBR09JZ3U5OURvVFdpVGc1SURETkl1MmwzQ0dmeXV5OUkyQXBZMC03Rl9oYU9kWnN6RHpDOFJFTzVXdW5QbEVSanlMTzBnWnlHaVJFXzhsN1BUbHkteGdJeXJzeU5zNWlLSlVoMkc4NTJLdg?oc=5). Tesla launched its first Cybercab robotaxis in Texas [2](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijwFBVV95cUxNVTdTeWNxeE9xLWkwZGxqQmlCVUQ2T1hOQ2x2WFFtaFNhWmhnWVJZbTQ1MEotWWZXTUh0V3lnX3IwQU5pSERvbnhmRGo3cFJWenFXVU5YT0hrQkR4U1FQN2t6R1FtLVZDY0ZtdERROGlwMWJGTWtZd2prZnRpTmJDalBjdERKWnBjUUs2WnYzUQ?oc=5). Texas has started real-world air taxi flights under a new federal program, with the Texas Department of Transportation confirming that air taxis are taking flight this fall [3](https://news.google.?oc=5). Joby Aviation completed its first New York City eVTOL flights from JFK to Manhattan in 7 minutes [3](https://news.google.?oc=5).

Sweden’s Freya Industries raised $620,000 to scale drone detection across Europe [4](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitgFBVV95cUxQSHNlWGpoNDFXZV81OWlWRWVWSVVBd1ZmSmFYNnVEWjJFYkNfdjI0eWdXY2pWM2VvZ0Q2bFVlZG5kUzRfV0dPcy1UQ005RGc1VEl6bjZYdkpTX0hQakd2anlpWGJUOVk0S2J2bUdXYS1NVTYyZHFiQVBQNzlXaGp5THg3bnVkdUVaLVRXbnFHQW1DUDlNQ2VVZHBVZFlGY3Z4MXZwMnBBbGV2OHplNlI1dlRGVnJkdw?oc=5). Poland unveiled the MAKO X1 man-portable counter-unmanned aerial system [4](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitgFBVV95cUxQSHNlWGpoNDFXZV81OWlWRWVWSVVBd1ZmSmFYNnVEWjJFYkNfdjI0eWdXY2pWM2VvZ0Q2bFVlZG5kUzRfV0dPcy1UQ005RGc1VEl6bjZYdkpTX0hQakd2anlpWGJUOVk0S2J2bUdXYS1NVTYyZHFiQVBQNzlXaGp5THg3bnVkdUVaLVRXbnFHQW1DUDlNQ2VVZHBVZFlGY3Z4MXZwMnBBbGV2OHplNlI1dlRGVnJkdw?oc=5). DroneShield is expanding its open counter-drone architecture and integrating with AIM Defence’s high-power laser system [4](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitgFBVV95cUxQSHNlWGpoNDFXZV81OWlWRWVWSVVBd1ZmSmFYNnVEWjJFYkNfdjI0eWdXY2pWM2VvZ0Q2bFVlZG5kUzRfV0dPcy1UQ005RGc1VEl6bjZYdkpTX0hQakd2anlpWGJUOVk0S2J2bUdXYS1NVTYyZHFiQVBQNzlXaGp5THg3bnVkdUVaLVRXbnFHQW1DUDlNQ2VVZHBVZFlGY3Z4MXZwMnBBbGV2OHplNlI1dlRGVnJkdw?oc=5). Leonardo signed a contract with Kongsberg for counter-unmanned aerial systems [4](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitgFBVV95cUxQSHNlWGpoNDFXZV81OWlWRWVWSVVBd1ZmSmFYNnVEWjJFYkNfdjI0eWdXY2pWM2VvZ0Q2bFVlZG5kUzRfV0dPcy1UQ005RGc1VEl6bjZYdkpTX0hQakd2anlpWGJUOVk0S2J2bUdXYS1NVTYyZHFiQVBQNzlXaGp5THg3bnVkdUVaLVRXbnFHQW1DUDlNQ2VVZHBVZFlGY3Z4MXZwMnBBbGV2OHplNlI1dlRGVnJkdw?oc=5). The Irish Aviation Authority successfully prosecuted a drone pilot for failing to comply with restricted airspace regulations [5](https://www.suasnews.com/2026/09/iaa-successfully-prosecutes-drone-pilot-for-infringing-on-restricted-airspace/).

Russia proposed building its Ivolga FG high-speed trains in India [6](https://news.google.?oc=5). Alstom began testing the first driverless train for Santiago’s Line 7 [6](https://news.google.?oc=5). The European Union released $7 billion for Ukraine to buy Patriot missiles and drones [7](https://euromaidanpress.com/2026/09/12/the-eu-just-released-7-billion-for-ukraine-to-buy-patriot-missiles-and-drones/). U.S. and Philippine Marines linked Hermes drone surveillance with BrahMos targeting against simulated Chinese warships during ACDC 26.4 in northern Luzon [8](https://www.armyrecognition.com/news/navy-news/2026/u-s-and-philippine-marines-link-hermes-drones-to-brahmos-strikes-against-simulated-chinese-warships). AeroVironment landed the first production contract for directed-energy weapons in U.S. military history [9](https://247wallst.com/investing/2026/09/11/aerovironment-ceo-10-per-shot-laser-beats-150000-drones-but-stock-keeps-falling/).
